Questions & Answers

What’s included in the free trial?

Send us up to 50 pages in a regular envelope. We scan them with full OCR and email you the searchable PDFs. No charge, no commitment. You see exactly what the full service delivers.

What if I have more than 2,500 pages?

Send multiple boxes. Volume discounts kick in at 3+ boxes. Contact us for a custom quote on large projects.

Where do I ship my documents?

ClearingStation Ltd.
1460 Chevrier Blvd #200
Winnipeg, MB R3T 1Y6
Any carrier works — Canada Post, Purolator, FedEx, UPS.

How long does the whole process take?

5 business days from the day we receive your documents. We email a confirmation when they arrive and again when your files are ready. Most customers have their PDFs within 2–3 weeks of mailing.

Do you return my originals?

Your choice. We return them via Canada Post (shipping at cost) or securely shred them.

What’s the money-back guarantee?

If you’re not satisfied with the scan quality on a paid box, we redo it or refund you in full. No questions asked.

What file format do I get?

Searchable PDF by default. Every page is OCR-processed so you can find any word or phrase. TIFF or JPEG available on request.
